related.title: SQLite：轉帳交易的原子性與 rollback
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在查詢改寫前後同時核對多重集合與 NULL，避免只比總筆數。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare multisets and NULLs before and after query rewrites rather than checking row counts alone. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 建立兩個帳戶並在扣款後故意拋出錯誤，證明交易未部分生效。
related.differenceEn: Create two accounts and inject an exception after debit to demonstrate all-or-nothing effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: EXCEPT 通常採集合語意，可能忽略重複次數；多重集合比對需將所有輸出欄位分組並比較 COUNT。 教學基準：2+1+1 = 4 rows in A；第二檢核：abs(2-1)+abs(1-2) = 2 frequency discrepancy。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
原子性把一組寫入視為一個提交單位；應用程式必須明確處理例外並 rollback。 教學基準：1000+400 = 1400 conserved balance；第二檢核：1000-150 = 850 successful A balance。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: EXCEPT uses set semantics and may hide multiplicity changes; multiset comparison groups every output field and compares counts. Teaching baseline: 2+1+1 = 4 rows in A; second check: abs(2-1)+abs(1-2) = 2 frequency discrepancy. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Atomicity makes grouped writes one commit unit; application exceptions require explicit rollback handling. Teaching baseline: 1000+400 = 1400 conserved balance; second check: 1000-150 = 850 successful A balance. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 交易 outbox：資料提交與事件送達的分界
related.titleEn: Transactional outbox: database commit versus event delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在查詢改寫前後同時核對多重集合與 NULL，避免只比總筆數。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare multisets and NULLs before and after query rewrites rather than checking row counts alone. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 把訂單和待發事件同交易寫入，再用可重播 dispatcher 避免提交與傳送間遺失。
related.differenceEn: Write an order and pending event atomically,then use a replayable dispatcher to avoid gaps between commit and send.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: EXCEPT 通常採集合語意，可能忽略重複次數；多重集合比對需將所有輸出欄位分組並比較 COUNT。 教學基準：2+1+1 = 4 rows in A；第二檢核：abs(2-1)+abs(1-2) = 2 frequency discrepancy。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Outbox 解決資料庫更新與發送意圖的原子性；接收端仍需去重，不能宣稱外部副作用自動 exactly-once。 教學基準：1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay；第二檢核：3 = 3 unique applied events。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: EXCEPT uses set semantics and may hide multiplicity changes; multiset comparison groups every output field and compares counts. Teaching baseline: 2+1+1 = 4 rows in A; second check: abs(2-1)+abs(1-2) = 2 frequency discrepancy. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Outbox atomically records data and send intent; receivers still need deduplication and external side effects are not automatically exactly-once. Teaching baseline: 1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay; second check: 3 = 3 unique applied events. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
